evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.intro: Files that show the controls work. Each file keeps its SHA-256 fingerprint, so anyone can check later that it hasn't changed.
evidence.needsControl: Accept a control first: evidence always supports an accepted control.
evidence.copyFailed: We couldn't copy it. Select the fingerprint and copy it yourself.

uploadDialog.title: Upload evidence
uploadDialog.description: Choose the file and the controls it shows working. The file can't be changed afterwards.
uploadDialog.taskDescription: The file goes to whoever asked for it, and this task is then done.
uploadDialog.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, text, CSV, Word, Excel or PowerPoint, up to {size}.

requestDialog.title: Request evidence
requestDialog.description: Ask a colleague for a file. They'll find the request in their tasks.

errors.empty: The file is empty. Choose another file.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than {size}. Choose a smaller file.
errors.typeNotAllowed: This kind of file can't be uploaded. Use PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, text, CSV, Word, Excel or PowerPoint.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read the file. Please choose it again.
errors.controlNotAccepted: That control is no longer accepted on this risk. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.invalid: Something in the form isn't accepted. Check it and try again.
errors.notFound: This is no longer open to you.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't send that. Please try again in a moment.

download.notFound: This file doesn't exist, or you can't download it.
download.unavailable: The file couldn't be downloaded right now. Please try again in a moment.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.intro: What you have been asked to do: send a file, finish an action or look at a risk again.
tasks.completedByApproval: Completed when the risk was approved
tasks.doneDialogDescription: You can leave a note about what was done.

approval.title: Approval
approval.intro: A complete risk is submitted for approval. Someone who didn't report it approves it, or returns it with a comment.

blockers.missingImpact: Set how bad it would be.
blockers.missingTreatment: Choose how to handle the risk.

rule.reviewerMayApprove: Its reviewer or an approver may approve it.
rule.independentApprover: Someone other than its reviewer must approve it.

approval.noEligibleApprover: No one else can approve this yet — an administrator can give the approver role to someone

refusal.reporter: You reported this risk, so someone else must approve it.
refusal.reviewerNeedsIndependent: This risk is above your appetite or accepted, so someone other than its reviewer must approve it.
refusal.notApprover: You don't hold the approver role for this risk.

approval.commentHint: Optional when you approve. Needed when you return the risk.
approval.commentRequired: Write why you're returning the risk.

errors.invalidTransition: This risk is no longer waiting for that step. Reload the page to see where it is.
errors.invalid: That comment isn't accepted. Check it and try again.
errors.forbidden: You can't do this for this risk.
errors.notFound: This risk is no longer open to you.
errors.notAccepted: That wasn't accepted. Please reload and try again.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't send that. Please try again in a moment.
